title: Lithium-Ion Battery Cell with Silicon-Graphite Composite Anode
full_text: A lithium-ion battery cell comprising a composite anode of silicon nanoparticles bonded to a graphite matrix, improving specific capacity while limiting volumetric expansion during charge cycles through a cross-linked polymer binder.

title: Solid-State Battery with Ceramic Electrolyte Layer
full_text: A solid-state battery employing a garnet-type ceramic electrolyte layer sandwiched between a lithium metal anode and a layered oxide cathode, reducing dendrite formation and enabling higher energy density than liquid-electrolyte cells.

title: Resonant Inductive Wireless Charging Coil Array
full_text: A wireless charging system using an array of overlapping resonant coils tuned to a common frequency, allowing free-positioning charging of a receiver device across an extended charging surface without manual alignment.

title: Multi-Device Wireless Charging Pad with Foreign Object Detection
full_text: A wireless charging pad capable of simultaneously charging multiple devices, incorporating a foreign object detection circuit that measures impedance shifts to disable power transfer when a non-compatible metallic object is present.

title: Edge-Deployed Neural Network Inference Accelerator
full_text: An application-specific integrated circuit for low-power neural network inference at the edge, featuring a systolic array of multiply-accumulate units and on-chip weight compression to reduce memory bandwidth requirements.

title: Quantized Transformer Model Compression Method
full_text: A method for compressing transformer-based language models via post-training quantization combined with structured pruning of attention heads, preserving downstream task accuracy while reducing model size by an order of magnitude.

title: Gravity-Fed Multi-Stage Water Filtration Cartridge
full_text: A replaceable filtration cartridge combining activated carbon, ion-exchange resin, and a hollow-fiber membrane in sequential stages, removing sediment, chlorine, and dissolved heavy metals under gravity feed without external power.

title: Ultraviolet-C Point-of-Use Water Disinfection Module
full_text: A point-of-use water disinfection module using a UV-C LED array with a helical flow path that maximizes ultraviolet dosage per unit volume, inactivating waterborne pathogens without chemical additives.

title: Obstacle-Avoidance Flight Controller for Autonomous Drones
full_text: A flight control system for unmanned aerial vehicles that fuses stereo-camera depth maps with LiDAR point clouds in real time to compute collision-free trajectories through cluttered environments at low latency.

title: Swarm Coordination Protocol for Multi-Drone Delivery
full_text: A decentralized coordination protocol allowing a fleet of delivery drones to negotiate airspace and delivery windows via peer-to-peer messaging, avoiding a single point of failure in centralized traffic management.

title: Capacitive Fingerprint Sensor with Anti-Spoofing Layer
full_text: A capacitive fingerprint sensor incorporating a sub-dermal capacitance layer that distinguishes live tissue from synthetic replicas, mitigating spoofing attacks using molded or printed fingerprint replicas.

title: Multi-Modal Biometric Authentication Combining Iris and Voice
full_text: An authentication system that fuses iris pattern recognition with voiceprint analysis using a weighted confidence score, reducing false-acceptance rates compared to either biometric modality used independently.

title: Bifacial Photovoltaic Panel with Rear-Side Light Trapping
full_text: A bifacial solar panel with a textured rear reflector layer that redirects albedo-reflected light back into the silicon substrate, increasing total energy yield in ground-mounted installations.

title: Perovskite-Silicon Tandem Solar Cell Stack
full_text: A tandem photovoltaic cell combining a perovskite top cell with a crystalline silicon bottom cell joined by a transparent conductive interlayer, extending the absorbed solar spectrum and raising overall conversion efficiency.

title: Multi-Material Fused Deposition 3D Printing Nozzle
full_text: A 3D printing extruder nozzle with independently heated internal channels allowing rapid switching between two or more filament materials within a single print without a full nozzle purge cycle.

title: In-Situ Defect Detection for Laser Powder-Bed Fusion
full_text: A monitoring system for metal additive manufacturing that analyzes melt-pool thermal imaging in real time to detect porosity and lack-of-fusion defects during the build, flagging layers for post-process inspection.

title: Sensor Fusion Method for Autonomous Vehicle Lane Keeping
full_text: A lane-keeping method for autonomous vehicles that fuses camera lane-marking detection with high-definition map priors and inertial measurement data, maintaining accurate lane position estimates during temporary marking occlusion.

title: Predictive Pedestrian Intent Model for Urban Driving
full_text: A machine learning model that predicts pedestrian crossing intent from gait kinematics and gaze direction captured by onboard cameras, enabling earlier braking decisions in autonomous urban driving scenarios.

title: Sharded Consensus Protocol for Distributed Ledgers
full_text: A consensus protocol that partitions a distributed ledger into shards processed in parallel by disjoint validator subsets, periodically committing cross-shard state roots to a beacon chain to preserve global consistency.

title: Zero-Knowledge Proof Scheme for Private Token Transfers
full_text: A zero-knowledge proof construction enabling verification of token transfer validity on a public ledger without revealing sender, recipient, or transfer amount, using a succinct non-interactive argument of knowledge.

title: CRISPR Guide RNA Design Method for Off-Target Reduction
full_text: A computational method for designing CRISPR guide RNAs that scores candidate sequences against a genome-wide off-target database, selecting guides that maximize on-target cleavage while minimizing predicted off-target activity.

title: Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation for mRNA Delivery
full_text: A lipid nanoparticle formulation combining an ionizable lipid, a PEGylated lipid, and cholesterol in a defined molar ratio, encapsulating messenger RNA for efficient cellular uptake and endosomal escape.

title: Compliant Robotic Gripper with Variable Stiffness Fingers
full_text: A robotic gripper with fingers containing granular jamming chambers that transition between compliant and rigid states under vacuum, allowing a single gripper to handle both delicate and heavy irregular objects.

title: Collaborative Robot Arm Force-Limiting Safety System
full_text: A safety system for collaborative robot arms that monitors joint torque in real time and triggers a compliant stop within milliseconds of unexpected contact, meeting human-robot collision force thresholds.

title: Extreme Ultraviolet Photomask Defect Repair Technique
full_text: A repair technique for extreme ultraviolet photomask defects using a focused electron beam to locally deposit absorber material, correcting sub-wavelength pattern defects prior to wafer exposure.

title: 3D Stacked Memory Die with Through-Silicon Vias
full_text: A stacked memory architecture connecting multiple DRAM dies via through-silicon vias, reducing signal path length and power consumption compared to conventional wire-bonded package-on-package memory.

title: Foveated Rendering Pipeline for Virtual Reality Headsets
full_text: A rendering pipeline for virtual reality headsets that reduces shading resolution outside the eye-tracked foveal region, cutting GPU workload while preserving perceived visual sharpness at the point of gaze.

title: Passthrough Mixed Reality Occlusion Compositing Method
full_text: A compositing method for mixed reality headsets that estimates real-world depth from stereo passthrough cameras to correctly occlude virtual objects behind physical objects in the user's field of view.

title: Remote Vital Sign Monitoring via Millimeter-Wave Radar
full_text: A contactless vital sign monitoring device that extracts heart rate and respiration rate from micro-Doppler shifts detected by a millimeter-wave radar sensor, suitable for continuous monitoring without wearable contact.

title: Asynchronous Video Consultation Triage Platform
full_text: A telemedicine platform that triages patient-submitted video and questionnaire data using a rules-based severity classifier, routing cases to the appropriate care tier before a live clinician consultation.

title: Federated Learning Aggregation with Differential Privacy
full_text: A federated learning aggregation method that adds calibrated noise to client model updates before server-side averaging, bounding the differential privacy loss of any individual participant's training data.

title: Graph Neural Network Model for Molecular Property Prediction
full_text: A graph neural network architecture that represents molecules as atom-bond graphs and predicts physicochemical properties via message-passing layers followed by a permutation-invariant readout function.

title: Adaptive Bitrate Streaming Controller Using Reinforcement Learning
full_text: A video streaming bitrate controller trained via reinforcement learning to select encoding bitrate based on predicted network throughput and buffer occupancy, reducing rebuffering events versus heuristic controllers.

title: Acoustic Leak Detection System for Underground Pipelines
full_text: A pipeline monitoring system using distributed fiber-optic acoustic sensing to detect the characteristic frequency signature of fluid leaks along buried pipeline segments, localizing leaks to within a few meters.

title: Modular Vertical Farming Rack with Closed-Loop Irrigation
full_text: A stackable vertical farming rack with an integrated closed-loop irrigation system that recirculates nutrient solution through each tier, monitoring conductivity and pH to automatically dose nutrients between cycles.

title: Thermal Runaway Containment Barrier for EV Battery Packs
full_text: A battery pack enclosure incorporating an intumescent barrier layer between adjacent cell modules that expands under high temperature to block thermal propagation from a cell undergoing thermal runaway.

title: Voice Activity Detection Front-End for Low-Power Wake Word Devices
full_text: A low-power voice activity detection circuit that gates a downstream wake-word neural network, using a coarse energy-based classifier implemented in analog hardware to minimize always-on power draw.

title: Digital Twin Simulation Framework for Factory Line Optimization
full_text: A digital twin framework that mirrors a physical factory line's sensor telemetry in a discrete-event simulation, enabling what-if throughput analysis before physical reconfiguration of the production line.

title: Self-Healing Polymer Coating for Corrosion Resistance
full_text: A polymer coating containing microencapsulated healing agent that ruptures under mechanical damage, releasing a cross-linking resin that seals the breach and restores corrosion resistance at the damaged site.

title: Context-Aware Ranking Model for Cross-Patent Prior-Art Retrieval
full_text: A retrieval-augmented ranking model for patent prior-art search that combines dense semantic embeddings of claim language with citation-graph proximity features, re-ranking candidate prior art beyond raw vector similarity.
